content.description: Isometric view of vehicle rear body structure showing luggage compartment with measurement points marked. Shows opened hatch/trunk area with body frame, panels, and structural elements. Two measurement points are marked with 'x' symbols on the luggage compartment floor area.
Detail view showing luggage compartment floor area with two dot markers indicating measurement reference points. Includes 'FR' directional arrow pointing forward.

content.text: NOTE: The luggage compartment measurement is performed between the two dot marked points as shown in the figure.
